notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the skill's only file). Workflow skill that makes the agent detect whether it is already in a linked worktree, ask the user for consent, prefer the harness's native worktree tool, otherwise fall back to `git worktree add` under .worktrees/, then install project dependencies and run baseline tests.

Medium because it directs state-changing actions: creating a branch and worktree (SKILL.md:96), adding the worktree directory to .gitignore and committing it if not ignored (SKILL.md:86), and auto-running project installers/builds (`npm install`, `cargo build`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, `poetry install`, `go mod download`, SKILL.md:107-118), which fetch packages and can execute the project's install scripts. Acceptable because worktree creation is gated on user consent (SKILL.md:41-45), the commands operate only on the user's own repository, nothing is pushed, merged or deleted, and failing tests are reported back to the user rather than overridden (SKILL.md:130).

The .gitignore commit happens without a separate confirmation; users who want every commit approved should note this. References to native tools such as EnterWorktree are optional, harness-dependent suggestions.
